note: France fiscal authority paths. Macro = DG Trésor RESF (annexed to PLF). State deficit = Budget/PLF solde budgétaire hors FMI (déficit à financer in the financing table) — same concept as the SMB cash requirement. Debt charge and +100bp triangle = AFT. Financing totals (besoin, BTF, net MLT) stay in plan.json. Category annuals = PLF équilibre / Voies et moyens (net State taxes). Not AMECO/WEO.

state_deficit.source: PLF tableau de financement / solde budgétaire de l'État (hors opérations FMI)
state_deficit.unit: EUR bn, calendar year (positive = deficit to finance)

2025.vintage: outturn (SMB full year; authority path starts at PLF vintages)

state_deficit.note: v2 soft-pins the category path to these totals (SOFT_PIN_ALPHA=1) when the PLF vintage is known at the origin (Oct Y−1). Live forward uses the same pin inside bottom_up_macro; plan.json déficit_to_finance matches. AFT's besoin = deficit + amortisation + other treasury needs.

macro.source: DG Trésor Rapport économique, social et financier (RESF)

2025.vintage: RESF PLF 2026 (15-Oct-2025); superseded for 2026 by RESF 2027

2026.vintage: RESF PLF 2027 (6-Oct-2026); government update 11-Sep-2026; masse salariale from RESF/PLF text

2027.vintage: RESF PLF 2027 (6-Oct-2026); masse salariale +2.4% RESF text

macro.ngdp_rule: real_growth + cpi (no separate nominal GDP print used; RESF frames receipts on activity + prices)
macro.rfn_elasticity_note: Voies et moyens PLF 2026: RFN spontaneous elasticity to NGDP 1.2 (2025) / 0.5 (2026). IR PAS tracks masse salariale; TVA tracks emplois taxables ≈ NGDP; IS tracks bénéfice fiscal ≈ NGDP lag.

elasticities.source: RESF / Voies priors. Open-year growth OFF except remboursements_locaux (same-year CPI). 2023 PLF exécution fill + AFT 2024 charge 50.1 — PRE-gated; among clearers best OOS. 2022 fill documented but not pinned (OOS regress). Tax leaf growth fails worse_h; aggregate growth blocked; triangle inert with remb.

ship_knobs.note: SOFT_PIN_ALPHA=1 (PLF solde pin when known). PRE flat vs α=0; OOS 8.88→8.06. Categories keep the monthly shape; pin removes annual level drift vs déficit à financer. Open-year tax leaf growth still fails PRE — hold + remb CPI only.

ir.note: PAS / salaires déclarés track masse salariale (Voies et moyens); open-year hold

is.note: bénéfice fiscal ≈ nominal activity; open-year hold

tva.note: emplois taxables; RESF medium-term ε≈1; open-year hold

accises.note: energy volumes; clears PRE alone but remb+int1 wins OOS

non_fiscal.note: discrete one-offs (PNRR, CDC, BdF) — PLF path when known; else hold

credits_ministeriels.note: nominal spending; PDE freeze years pinned by PLF; open-year growth clears PRE but OOS worse than remb+AFT50.1 hold

remboursements_locaux.note: SHIP leaf: same-year CPI prior when PLF unknown

psr.note: CT + UE; UE path discrete when PLF known; open-year hold

charge.note: AFT charge budgétaire when known (2024 exécution 50.1); else hold; month carve 100% smly

solde_comptes_speciaux.note: PLF path when known (2024−27); else SMB moy mean

solde_budgets_annexes.note: PLF path when known; else 0 / last-year

categories.source: PLF équilibre / Voies et moyens / chiffres clés / CdC NEB / AFT charge (recettes nettes État; crédits hors FdC)
categories.note: PLF for year Y treated as known from October Y−1 (budget deposit). Values are net State perimeter (RFN after R&D État). Pinned: 2023 (PLF 2025) + 2024–27. 2022 exécution lives in published_execution (pin raises OOS). Extracts: data/fr/plf_extracts/.

2023.vintage: PLF 2025 exposé équilibre — exécution 2023; tax split CdC NEB 2024 / Voies PLF 2025
2023.note: PLF 2025 table: crédits 336.1, charge yc SNCF 54.8, amort covid 6.6 + CAS contrib 45.5 → cas_pensions 52.1, remb locaux 5.1, PSR 68.1. Identity → déficit 173.0.

2024.vintage: PLF 2026 chiffres clés spend + Voies tax; remb locaux CdC 5.0; charge AFT exécution 50.1
2024.note: PDE crédits 327.0, PSR 67.8, BA 0.4, CS −2.3 from PLF 2026 chiffres clés; remb locaux 5.0 CdC; charge AFT 50.1; cas_pensions residual to dépenses 502.8

published_execution.note: Complete exécution rows kept for documentation / share priors. 2022 new-perimeter fill clears PRE but raises OOS vs 2023-only (9.09 alone / 8.97 with AFT50.1) — not pinned into the live path.

2022.vintage: CdC NEB 2022 recettes (new-perimeter RFN) + AFT charge + AN remb locaux; spend residual to déficit 151.4
2022.note: RFN 330.3 = old 323.3 + remb locaux 7.0 (LOLF reform comparable). charge AFT net budgetary 51.5 (pgm117 50.7 + SNCF). cas=44.4 contributions + 1.9 amort covid. PSR CT+UE 43.0+24.2. CS +6.7 CdC.

debt_charge.source: AFT / LFI charge budgétaire de la dette (programme 117)

2022.vintage: AFT key figures — exécution (net budgetary; pgm117 50.7)

2023.vintage: AFT key figures / PLF 2025 — exécution yc SNCF

2024.vintage: AFT key figures — exécution 2024 (net budgetary); supersedes PLF chiffres 46.9

debt_charge.note: AFT net budgetary cost when available; categories.years[*].charge may use PLF chiffres for the same year when that is the équilibre source (e.g. 2024 PLF 46.9 vs AFT 50.1).

rate_shock.source: AFT: permanent +100bp parallel shift vs reference curve (Senate Rapport général PLF 2026 / Rapport sur la dette)
rate_shock.unit: EUR bn extra charge de la dette
rate_shock.note: Interpolate linearly in years from the published 1/5/9 points for scenario years beyond year 1.
